question: In which group are the non-metal elements placed in a vertical column on the right side of the periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Group 17__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Halogens are a group of six elements of Group 17 in the periodic table.

 
 
• Fluorine (F)
 
• Chlorine (Cl)
 
• Bromine (Br)
 
• Iodine (I)
 
• Astat
